rules.description: The verifying authority must approve each request within a specified time frame.
rules.condition: A request is submitted to the verifying authority.
rules.outcome: The request must be approved within 30 days period.
rules.evidence_quote: and verifying authority needs to approve the request within 30 days period.

rules.description: Institutes, schools, or courses added before a cutoff date are eligible only for the current scholarship cycle.
rules.condition: The institute/school/course is added before 30th September, 2017.
rules.outcome: It will be allowed to participate in the scholarship process for 2017-18 only.
rules.evidence_quote: However, Institutes/Schools/Courses added before the last date i.e. 30th September, 2017 will be only allowed to participate in the scholarship process for 2017-18.

rules.description: After being added, institutes or schools may modify only their contact information.
rules.condition: The institute/school has already been added to the system.
rules.outcome: They may be allowed to change only their contact details.
rules.evidence_quote: Further, once added, the Institutes/Schools may be allowed to change only their contact details.

rules.description: Requests to modify metadata such as course registration or fee must undergo verification.
rules.condition: A request is made to change metadata (e.g., course registered, course fee).
rules.outcome: The request will be subject to verification and acceptance by the concerned verifying authority.
rules.evidence_quote: Any request to change the metadata (course registered, course fee etc.) will be subject to verification and acceptance by the concerned verifying authority.

rules.description: All verifying authorities must refresh and validate their metadata at the start of each academic cycle.
rules.condition: The beginning of every academic cycle.
rules.outcome: They are required to update their metadata (including contact details and course details) and get it validated.
rules.evidence_quote: All existing verifying Authorities, in all cases, are, however, necessarily required to update their metadata (including contact details and course details) and get it validated in the beginning of every academic cycle.
